column1: # Campaign 27 source evidence for typed prepared parameter-marker admission.

column5: The Rust parser assigns typed parameter-marker positions left-to-right, resets numbering for every statement, and the configured planner binds exactly one signed BIGINT primary-key marker before ordinary ReadOnlyScanPlan lowering; the rest of TiDB's parser lifecycle, SQL modes, diagnostics, parser reuse contract, SQL PREPARE/EXECUTE semantics, and all non-point-read marker shapes remain open. This is parser/planner safety evidence only and does not claim a working COM_STMT runtime.
